idea-plugin.name: IKE Working-Set Leases
idea-plugin.description:
Enforces single-writer working-set leases across Syncthing-paired machines. Opening a project acquires its lease; a lease held live by another machine raises a takeover dialog. When this machine is fenced by a takeover elsewhere, open documents are saved and the project is closed so the work reaches the machine taking over.

Design: dev-working-set-lease in ike-lab-documents; implementation tracked in IKE-Network/ike-issues#1002.
